proposals.title: Ridgeline Clean Energy Act
proposals.summary_plain: Authorizes ridge-top wind and solar on designated state land, a 90-mile transmission line to carry it to the Watauga corridor, and a Just-Transition Fund for coal-county workers and tax bases. Cost recovery is capped under the Okafor amendment.
sections: Title I — Generation: leases ridge-top wind/solar on designated state land, with viewshed setbacks and county opt-in.
Title II — Transmission: authorizes a 90-mile line under FPUC oversight; competitive build contract.
Title III — Just-Transition Fund: retraining, bridge wages, and tax-base backfill for plateau coal counties.
Title IV (Okafor amendment) — Ratepayer cost cap: caps cost recovery passed to ratepayers and front-loads the Just-Transition Fund before construction.
proposals.outcome: Passed 6–4; signed by Gov. Aldridge after the Title IV cost-cap amendment.

votes.note: Flipped to yes only after his Title IV cost-cap amendment carried.
Land/water grounds, not donor-driven — the Investigation #1 control case.

proposals.title: Ratepayer Protection Act
proposals.summary_plain: Would cap utility rate increases and slow cost recovery on new transmission — the mirror image of HB-14's coalition. Failed.
proposals.outcome: Failed 4–6 (the inverse of HB-14: the four Ridgeline NO votes supported it; the six YES opposed).
